On this tour you read an archaeological park of fortifications and religious sites.

A day-by-day itinerary and a quotation are shared before you commit. Route, pace, accommodation and budget are adjusted to suit your group.

What it covers

  • Arrival and UNESCO orientation
  • Accessible Champaner monuments
  • Pavagadh sacred landscape viewpoints
  • Evidence mapping and cultural pluralism

Day by day

  1. Arrival and UNESCO orientation

  2. Accessible Champaner monuments

  3. Pavagadh sacred landscape viewpoints

  4. Evidence mapping and cultural pluralism

Days can be added, removed or reordered. The final itinerary comes with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Place Champaner-Pavagadh in its UNESCO context as an archaeological park of fortifications and religious sites.
  • Read the accessible Champaner monuments as parts of a fortified historic city.
  • Map the evidence across the sacred landscape of Pavagadh and discuss cultural pluralism.
